questions.text:
Question ONE relates to Nikau's Music Shop, a retail store selling musical instruments and accessories.

Complete the following general journal entries. Narrations have been provided.

Record the staff wages owing at year end: $1,480.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Staff wages 1,480 / Cr Accrued expenses 1,480.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct account names. V: Correct $ amount for both entries.

questions.text:
Record the invoices issued for sales not yet recorded: $2,070 including GST. The inventory cost price $810 excluding GST has been done for you.

(Cost of goods sold entry already provided: Dr COGS 810 / Cr Inventory 810)
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Accounts receivable 2,070 / Cr Sales 1,800 / Cr GST payable 270.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct account names. V: Correct amounts ($1,800 sales excl GST, $270 GST, $2,070 total). C: Correct Dr/Cr columns.

questions.text: Complete the prepayments general ledger account, showing all entries at 31 March 2024 including a closing entry if relevant.
questions.expectedAnswer: Opening balance Dr, adjustment entries (insurance 310, rates 480), closing balance carried down.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct stems. V: Correct $ amounts. C: Correct Dr/Cr sides. T: Closing entry with correct balance.

questions.text: Complete the Income Statement for Nikau's Music Shop for the year ended 31 March 2024. The total for administrative expenses ($19,870) has been provided.
questions.expectedAnswer: Revenue: Sales $418,500 less sales returns ($13,200) = Net sales $405,300. Cost of goods sold section. Gross profit. Selling expenses. Administrative expenses. Net profit.
questions.markingGuide:
V: Correct figures.

S: Correct account names/stems.

C: Correct classification.

T: Correct two-step calculations (e.g., COGS).

P: Correct layout, subtotals, and fit for purpose.

questions.text:
Question TWO relates to Nikau's Music Shop.

Record the invoice received for instrument repairs: $529 including GST.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Repairs and maintenance 460 / Dr GST payable 69 / Cr Accounts payable 529.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct stems. V: Correct amounts. C: Correct Dr/Cr.

questions.text: Record the closing entry for doubtful debts.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Income summary [amount] / Cr Doubtful debts [amount].
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct stems. V: Correct amount. T: Correct treatment as closing entry.

questions.text:
Complete the inventory general ledger account, showing all entries at 31 March 2024 including a closing entry if relevant.

Opening balance: 31/3/24 Balance 17,240 Dr.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr: Balance 17,240. Entries for purchases, sales (COGS), and closing balance.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct stems. V: Correct amounts. T: Two-step calculation of final balance. C: Correct Dr/Cr.

questions.text:
Complete the Note 2: Property, plant, and equipment (extract) of the Statement of Financial Position for Nikau's Music Shop as at 31 March 2024.

Shop fittings: Opening carrying amount $5,120.
questions.expectedAnswer: Opening $5,120 + Additions $2,600 - Disposals ($1,040) - Depreciation ($520) = Closing carrying amount.
questions.markingGuide: V: Correct figures. S: Correct stems. T: Correct calculation. P: Correct treatment and fit for purpose.

questions.text: Complete the Liabilities section of the Statement of Financial Position for Nikau's Music Shop as at 31 March 2024.
questions.expectedAnswer: Current liabilities: Accounts payable, GST payable, Accrued expenses. Non-current liabilities: Bank loan. Total liabilities.
questions.markingGuide:
V: Correct figures.

S: Correct account names.

C: Correct current/non-current classification.

T: Correct totals.

P: Fit for purpose layout.

questions.text: Complete the Equity section of the Statement of Financial Position for Nikau's Music Shop as at 31 March 2024.
questions.expectedAnswer: Opening capital + Profit for year - Drawings = Closing capital.
questions.markingGuide: V: Correct figures. S: Correct stems. P: Fit for purpose with correct equity calculation process.

questions.text:
Question THREE relates to Kōwhai Kids Playcentre, a childcare service.

Complete the general journal entry to record the interest received that is owed from a term deposit: $720. The narration has been provided.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Accrued income 720 / Cr Interest received 720.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct stems. V: Correct amount.

questions.text:
Complete the accounts receivable general ledger account to record the entries at 31 March 2024.

Opening: 01/04/23 Balance. Entries: 31/03/24 Fees received and GST, Bad debts and GST, Bank.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr: Balance 12,480. Appropriate entries for fees, bad debts, bank receipts.
questions.markingGuide: V: Correct amounts. S: Correct Dr/Cr sides. T: Correct balance calculation.

questions.text:
Calculate how much cash was received by Kōwhai Kids Playcentre for the sale of old playground equipment that would be reported in the cash receipts section of the Statement of Cash Flows.
Show and label your working.
questions.expectedAnswer: Carrying amount $520 + gain on disposal $150 = Cash from sale $670.
questions.markingGuide: C: Correct calculation. V: Correct final amount.

questions.text:
Calculate the cash paid to accounts payable for the year ended 31 March 2024.
Show and label your working.
questions.expectedAnswer: Opening AP + Invoices received - Discount received + Freight - Closing AP = Cash paid.
questions.markingGuide: V: Correct amounts. T: Correct working with labels. C: Correct final amount.

questions.text: Prepare the cash payments section of the Statement of Cash Flows for Kōwhai Kids Playcentre for the year ended 31 March 2024.
questions.expectedAnswer: Cash payments: Accounts payable, Drawings, Childcare expenses, Administrative expenses, etc. Total cash payments.
questions.markingGuide: V: Correct figures. S: Correct stems. C: Correct classification. P: Fit for purpose layout with subtotals.
